walls.name: Frame
walls.desc: The length prefix and exact-consumption check. Malformed frames are answered and the connection dropped — never the process.

walls.name: Codec
walls.desc: Every field decodes with bounds checks. Truncated or oversized input fails fast as a named error, never an allocation blow-up.

walls.name: Header seal
walls.desc: The seal is a Bandersnatch VRF over the whole unsigned header — including the author and the extrinsic-hash. Touch any of them without the validator's key and it no longer verifies.

walls.name: Extrinsic commitment
walls.desc: The extrinsic-hash commits to every extrinsic byte. Change the extrinsic and either this check fails, or — if you recompute it — the seal above does. There is no keyless gap between them.

classes.corrupts: Duplicate an assurance, then recompute the extrinsic hash.
classes.wall: the header seal (it signs the recomputed hash)

classes.corrupts: Swap two availability assurances, then recompute the extrinsic hash.
classes.wall: the header seal (it signs the recomputed hash)

classes.corrupts: Flip a bit in an assurance signature, then recompute the extrinsic hash.
classes.wall: the header seal (it signs the recomputed hash)

classes.corrupts: Set the author index past the validator count.
Name a different (valid) validator as author.
classes.wall: the header seal (signed by the real author's key)

classes.corrupts: Flip one bit in the header's extrinsic-hash commitment.
Append junk bytes after a well-formed block.
classes.wall: the frame check (trailing bytes after the body)

classes.corrupts: Flip a bit in a guarantee credential, then recompute the extrinsic hash.
classes.wall: the header seal (it signs the recomputed hash)

classes.corrupts: Flip one bit in the parent-block hash.
classes.wall: the parent lookup (no such block on this chain)

classes.corrupts: Flip one random bit anywhere in the block.
classes.wall: whichever layer the bit lands under (or none — a benign flip)

classes.corrupts: Flip one bit in the 96-byte block seal.
Swap two safrole tickets, then recompute the extrinsic hash.
classes.wall: the header seal (it signs the recomputed hash)

classes.corrupts: Cut a random tail off the encoded block.
classes.wall: the codec (decode runs out of bounds)

classes.corrupts: Flip one bit in the 96-byte entropy-source VRF signature.
